To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the preliminary X-ray diffractions analysis of Pax-8 in complex with the thyroglobin promoter was achieved and that the theoretical comparative model of Pax-8 shows the probable presence some specific protein-DN interactions and the important role in the redox regulation of the cysteines of the PAI domain.
we have obtained preliminary diffraction data from a mammalian Pax- 8 paired domain/DNA complex, and the data are sufficient for a preliminary structural analysis.
the Pax-8 PrD domain/DNA complex has been successfully crystallized and that preliminary diffraction analysis of this crystal has been achieved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural characterization of Pax-8 PrD/DNA complex.

the structural analysis of a mammalian Pax- 8 DNA-binding domain and the identification of the protein-DN A interactions that could be responsible of the transcription regulation in the thyroid follicular cells.
the structural analysis of the Pax- 8 paired domain and its DNA complex, and the results obtained will be useful for the design of new drugs for thyroid cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study is a good example of a preliminary X-ray structural study of the Pax-Prd/DNA complex.

the structural studies on Pax-8 paired domains in complex with DNA fragments will be useful to understand the mechanism of transcriptional regulation by Pax-8 and will be a useful tool for the design of specific Pax-8 DNA-binding molecules.
the Pax-8 PrD/DNA complex has been obtained and the structural analysis of this complex will provide a new insight in the molecular basis of Pax-8 DNA recognition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structural study on Pax-8 is in progress and we are now working to obtain better crystals.

the structural analysis of the Pax- 8 paired domain/DNA complex is a very important step in our research program on the structural and functional characterization of Pax proteins and in the understanding of the molecular mechanisms of the Pax proteins in the development of the thyroid follicular cells.
the Pax-8 PAI subdomain, which is involved in DNA-binding, has a redox sensitive cysteine that may play an important role in the control of transcriptional activation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the crystallization and preliminary X-ray analysis of the Pax- 8 paired domain in the presence of DNA fragments of different length and with different end sequences is possible.

the structural analysis of Pax-8 paired domains in complex with the DNA target is essential to understand the role of the Pax family in the development of follicular cells and to design new drugs against thyroid cancer.
the crystallization conditions of Pax-8 paired-domain in complex with the thyroglobuline promoter DNA are suitable for a high-resolution structural study.
